newsitem.title: JAPAN: Pop superstar Michael Jackson arrives in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Pop superstar Michael Jackson arrives in Japan.

text.p: Michael Jackson arrived in Japan on Wednesday to the cheers of thousands of fans waiting for him at Tokyo airport.
During his fifth visit to Japan, Jackson is to stage concerts for four days at the 56,000-capacity Tokyo Dome, and two in Fukuoka on Japan's southern island of Kyushu.
Of the six planned concerts, tickets have been sold out only for Sunday's concert in Tokyo, organisers said.
They said that Jackson was in Japan without the friend who he said last month had became pregnant with his child.
The woman, identified as Debbie Rowe, has been a close friend of the singer for 15 years and will have the baby in early 1997, according to a statement from Jackson's publicists.
Jackson will leave Japan for Brunei on December 29.
